lines.en: What most people regret is not the mistakes they made, but the chances they never took.
I wish I had listened more carefully when my grandmother told her stories.
If only we had known how quickly time passes, we would have spent more evenings together.
Not until we lose something do we fully understand its value.
However hard I try, I cannot remember the sound of my grandfather's laugh.
Were I to live my life again, I would worry less and travel more.
It is not the years in your life that count, but the life in your years.
If only the train had arrived five minutes earlier, I would have said goodbye properly.
I would rather fail at something I love than succeed at something that means nothing to me.
Rarely do we get second chances, so it is wiser to treat the first one with care.
What I would give to hear my father's voice one more time cannot be measured.
I wish I had learned a musical instrument when my mind was young and quick.
If only people understood earlier that health is the only wealth that truly matters.
Were he to admit his mistake, half the damage could still be repaired.
It is better to regret what you tried than to spend a lifetime wondering what might have happened.
